qualification: Cross-process cache publication and abrupt pre-publication exit on macOS

concurrent_writers.reader: Parent repeatedly loads destination while child writers run; each decoded cache must contain all 64 records of exactly one writer.
concurrent_writers.result: All publications and reader validations pass; final cache belongs to a child writer; no leftover temporary files after successful writers.

checkpoints: After complete-file flush/sync, before replacement, callback 67
abrupt_exit.result: Both exits preserve previous destination bytes and decoded contents. Partial orphan is rejected; complete synchronized orphan is valid but is not published. A subsequent save publishes a valid new cache.

limits: macOS local filesystem only; no Linux/Windows cache process qualification.
Process exit bypasses Rust destructors; this is not power loss or kernel/filesystem crash.
Directory-entry durability and orphan reclamation are not implemented or proved.
Last-publication semantics do not merge concurrent writer contents.
Automatic complete decoder/recipe identity remains an independent requirement.
